lines: הָבָה נְרוֹמְמֵהוּ יַחַד, כִּי נִפְלָא שְׁמוֹ

review: The hymn is a litany on the Name: 1:1–3 is Ps 8:2 (מַה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ) with Ps 138:2, 2:1–2 Acts 4:12 with Isa 53:5, 3:1–2 Prov 18:10 (מִגְדַּל־עֹז) with Ps 18:3, 4:1–2 John 14:13–14, 5:1–2 Isa 7:14 with Matt 1:23, 6:1–2 1 Tim 6:15 with Dan 7:14, and 7:1–2 Ps 118:14 with 1 Cor 15:57.
Stanza 1 prints three lines and the rest two (3/2/2/2/2/2/2) — the payload keeps the shape, because the print opens with the doubled exclamation before settling into couplets.

1:1–2 keep both exclamations as rhetorical questions of the psalm kind (Ps 8:2, 31:20), since Hebrew cannot put the abstract 'greatness' in the vocative. 3:1 keeps מִגְדַּל־עֹז untranslated as the fixed phrase of Prov 18:10.
